scope: Sealed prediction/publication and evidence coverage only; no GT, scoring outcomes, physical identity accuracy, or method gain claim.
interpretation_boundaries: EVENT_RGB and EVENT_RGBD actual outputs and decisions are exact; any common change cannot be attributed exclusively to added depth.
Depth changes scores in four windows but not the physical mapping, stage/error, or any final prediction.

A short continuous pre fragment can still be several seconds before the post fragment; direct endpoint flow is not adjacent-frame flow. Long intervals are a plausible contributor to insufficient support, not isolated causal proof.
Contour common-null requires every compared edge sample qualified; unavailable entries are retained. Wrong-hypothesis versus unreliable-measurement effects have not been separated by a new ablation.

Depth row background=None is also the uninitialized field when history/current quality fails; it does not by itself prove missing background. Inspect actual forecast statuses and current quality in depth_unique_rows.
A single-compatible core can remain unusable because actual whole-mask mixture is independently flagged. No filtering and stitching of surviving pre samples occurred.
Changed frame counts are publication differences relative to Z4Q, not GT-certified errors.
No frozen source, threshold, prompt, old seal, or previously published prediction was modified.
